svg.text: s2d_mpdda_pd: s2d_mpdda with a digital enable (en_3v3: 0 ... 3.3 V on vdd / vss, active high; en_3v3_b from en_ctrl_3v3)
Disabled: TPN / TPP and TNN / TNP tie voutp and voutn to vcm; the bias (bias_sel_pd) switches off every tail, sink, cascode and the CMFB diode.
Enabled: the four switches are off; s2d_mpdda unchanged. vin, vref, vcm drive gates only. Source: ../../netlist/source/s2d_pd.spice
[DM] dummies of the s2d layout cells, as drawn (pad_candidate.cdl, C3 2026-11-04); every one a device, D = S on the rail
PMOS (D = S = B = vdd): MDT inputs (4 tubs 20u / 1u ng 2, gate vdd), MDTL tails (gate vbp), MDPC casc_p (gate vbpc); loads MDL: in s2d_mpdda (gate vcmfb)
NMOS (D = S = B = vss): MDSK sinks + MDBNT the twin of BN, MDSC sinks_cmfb (gate vbn), MDCN casc_n (gate vbnc); RD: the 2 dummy rhigh strips (vss)
BP / BN / BPC / BNC are drawn in the s2d cells but stay in bias_tree_noab_pd (same flat netlist).
